description: This file provides synchronization utilities for API locking, including thread-local flags, template-based lock management, function wrapping for thread-safe method calls, and guard classes for managing lock states during operations.

classes.name: Utils::Synchro::ApiLocks
classes.description: A template structure maintaining a recursive mutex for each class type, used to coordinate thread-safe API calls.

classes.name: Utils::Synchro::UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: A guard that temporarily unlocks the class-specific mutex if the thread is currently using the locked API, enabling safe recursive or cross-plugin calls.

classes.name: Utils::Synchro::LockApiGuard
classes.description: A guard for managing lock scope on the class-specific mutex, providing explicit lock and unlock methods.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Wraps a class method with synchronization logic, returning a std::function that locks the relevant mutex, sets thread-local flag, and executes the method safely.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a class method as a JSON-RPC method with automatic locking and thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a class method for specified versions with thread-safe locking.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a class method with a JSONRPC::Handler with thread safety.
